titel: Create the online store at Turso
kurz: The online store is where your PC and the online page exchange data. You create it once and enter its address and key in the AMW.
brauchst: The AMW runs on this PC (the watcher is set up).

schritte.text: Sign in at turso.tech and create a database (“Create Database”). Any name works; pick a location near you.
The database page shows the address (“Database URL”). It starts with `libsql://` and ends in `.turso.io`.
On the same page choose “Create Token”: read and write, no expiry. Copy the key – it is shown only once.
In the AMW: Settings › Online store. Paste address and key and save. The AMW checks the connection, creates the tables and switches the sync on. The command `amw web einrichten` does the same.
The AMW says so: the sync starts with the next start of the watcher (control desk › Watcher › Restart).
Settings › Online store shows “key saved” and the sync is on. `amw web status` shows the last upload.

fehler: (address and key required) – The website address was copied instead of the “Database URL”, or a field is empty.
“nicht erreichbar oder Schlüssel abgelehnt – nichts gespeichert”
(not reachable or key rejected) – Either the key belongs to another database, is read-only or has expired (create a new one with read and write), or there is no internet connection right now.
The watcher is not running or was not restarted after you entered the values.
danach: Set up the online page: on first open it asks for the same address and key.
Do not store or share the key. The AMW keeps it on this PC only and never shows it.
fragen: For one or two projects the free Turso plan is enough.
What is kept in the online store?
A copy of what the online page shows, and the mailbox with what you do while away. The complete data stays on your PC.
How do I switch it off again?
Settings › Online store › sync off. The online page then shows the last state and accepts nothing more.
